questions.q: A genetic engineering experiment resulted in a new haemoglobin variant which exists primarily as $\alpha \beta$ dimers in solution. Based on the oxygen saturation curves of the variant (dashed line) and normal haemoglobin (solid line), it can be inferred that
options: the variant has a higher affinity to oxygen and shows non-cooperative behaviour.
the variant has a higher affinity to oxygen and shows cooperative behaviour.
the oxygen dissociation of the variant is less than $10 \%$ at 20 mm of Hg .
at sea level ( $\sim 150 \mathrm{~mm}$ of Hg ), animals with this variant of haemoglobin can survive better than the ones with normal haemoglobin.

questions.q: The correct statement with respect to arteries, veins and capillaries is:
options: Valves are absent in arteries, but present in veins and capillaries.
Pulse can be felt in veins and capillaries but not in arteries.
Valves are absent in arteries and capillaries but present in veins.
Pulse can be felt in arteries and veins but not in capillaries.
